The technology will support dynamic beam steering and enhanced data throughput for warfighter communications. RDW builds on existing RF capabilities and has already delivered over 200 flight antennas, positioning itself to expand its role in distributed military satellite networks.

headlines.title: Can Local Javelin Production Strengthen Lockheed Martin in India?
headlines.summary: Lockheed Martin and RTX Corporation's Javelin Joint Venture have signed a memorandum of understanding with Tata Advanced Systems to explore co-production of Javelin missiles in India. The initiative aims to establish final assembly and integration facilities in India while maintaining component production in the U.S., strengthening supply-chain resilience and supporting India's defense modernization goals.

headlines.title: Can Rocket Lab's SDN Contracts Boost Growth Opportunities?

The company will demonstrate satellite-to-ground interoperability using its Photon spacecraft, with operational demonstrations expected in 2027. This strategic opportunity could lead to additional military satellite communications work.

headlines.title: Argan's Q2 Beat Shows Power Strength as Industrial Margins Stay Soft
headlines.summary: Argan, Inc. (AGX) reported strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with earnings up 50.4% and revenue up 61.5%, beating consensus estimates. The Power segment drove margin strength with a 52.9% revenue increase and improved gross margins to 22.4%. However, Industrial revenues doubled but margins fell to 7.3% due to worsening project completion estimates. Management expects Industrial margins to remain below historical norms for another 1-2 quarters.

headlines.title: AGX Falls 28.1% in a Month as Backlog and Margin Risks Come Into Focus
headlines.summary: Argan, Inc. (AGX) shares fell 28.1% over a month despite strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with 61.5% revenue growth and 50.4% earnings increase. The decline reflects investor concerns over backlog contraction from $2.9B to $2.5B, deteriorating margins (gross margin fell to 19.3%, Industrial margin to 7.3%), and unpredictable project award timing. While the company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and strong growth metrics, elevated valuation at 33.1X trailing earnings and execution risks keep the investment case uncertain.

headlines.title: Building Automation System Market
headlines.summary: The building automation system market is undergoing structural transformation as hardware commoditizes while software, analytics, and building intelligence capture strategic value. The global BAS market, valued at $105.5 billion in 2026, is projected to reach $182.6 billion by 2033 at 8.2% CAGR. Key shifts include portfolio-level standardization replacing building-by-building procurement, cloud-based deployments displacing on-premise architectures, and cybersecurity becoming a primary procurement criterion. Large commercial owners are consolidating vendor relationships over the next 18 months, creating compounding advantages for early movers while independent system integrators face consolidation pressure.

headlines.summary: The building automation system market is undergoing structural transformation as hardware commoditizes while software, analytics, and building intelligence capture strategic value. The global BAS market, valued at $105.5 billion in 2026, is projected to reach $182.6 billion by 2033 at 8.2% CAGR. Key shifts include portfolio-level standardization replacing building-by-building procurement, cloud-based deployments displacing on-premise architectures, and cybersecurity becoming a primary procurement criterion. Large commercial owners are consolidating vendor relationships over the next 18 months, creating compounding advantages for early movers while independent system integrators face consolidation pressure.

headlines.summary: Marathon Petroleum is named Bull of the Day with expected 341% earnings growth driven by record-high crack spreads and strong refining margins, while Campbell's is named Bear of the Day after missing earnings, cutting its dividend for the first time since 2001, and guiding fiscal 2027 earnings down as much as 24% due to inflation and supply chain challenges.

headlines.title: Chevron's Venezuela JV Expansion: Time to Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
headlines.summary: Chevron plans over $7 billion in Venezuela investment targeting 600,000 barrels per day production, leveraging strong Q2 cash flow and faster-than-expected Hess synergies. However, the stock trades at a premium valuation compared to peers Eni and Repsol while facing geopolitical and execution risks in Venezuela. Analysts recommend a Hold rating, suggesting existing shareholders stay invested but new investors wait for better valuations.

headlines.title: Bull of the Day: Marathon Petroleum (MPC)
headlines.summary: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) is experiencing exceptional growth driven by record-high crack spreads in the refining industry. The company reported a 341% expected earnings increase for 2026, with a forward P/E of 8.2 despite shares reaching new highs. MPC has generated substantial cash flow, returning $2.8 billion to shareholders in Q2 2026 through dividends and buybacks. However, analysts caution this is a short-term opportunity dependent on volatile crack spreads.

headlines.summary: PBF Energy has surged 168.4% over the past year, outperforming its industry peers. The company is well-positioned to benefit from tight global product supplies, constrained refining capacity, and low product inventories, which are expected to support elevated refining margins. With a diversified refining footprint of six refineries and a Nelson Complexity Index of 12.8, PBF trades at a discount valuation of 5.03X trailing EV/EBITDA compared to the industry average of 5.61X, earning a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating.

headlines.title: Natural Gas Posts a 3% Weekly Gain on Supportive Demand Trends
headlines.summary: Natural gas prices gained 3% to $2.975/MMBtu as unusually warm weather boosted cooling demand and LNG export maintenance ended, increasing feedgas consumption by 12%. Storage builds trailed five-year averages, supporting prices, though strong U.S. production limited gains. The market shows improving demand dynamics with favorable supply-demand balance.

headlines.title: Here's Why a Hold Strategy Is Apt for Southern Company Stock Now
headlines.summary: Southern Company (SO) is positioned to benefit from surging data center demand with over 17 GW of contracted load and an $81B capital plan supporting 9% rate-base growth. However, high capital requirements, equity dilution needs, rising borrowing costs, and regulatory risks present challenges. The stock has underperformed peers by 3% over the past 12 months, prompting analysts to recommend waiting for a better entry point.

headlines.title: EXC vs. NEE: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
headlines.summary: In a comparison of two major utility stocks, Exelon (EXC) emerges as the more attractive option for value investors compared to NextEra Energy (NEE). EXC holds a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with a forward P/E of 15.24 and Value grade of B, while NEE has a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold) with a forward P/E of 20.80 and Value grade of D. EXC's lower valuation metrics and stronger analyst outlook make it the preferred choice for value-focused investors.

headlines.title: Why Exelon (EXC) is a Great Dividend Stock Right Now
headlines.summary: Exelon (EXC), a Chicago-based utility company, offers an attractive dividend yield of 3.85%, above its industry average of 3.17%. With an annualized dividend of $1.68 (up 5% year-over-year) and a sustainable 60% payout ratio, the company is positioned for modest earnings growth with 2026 consensus estimates at $2.86 per share. Zacks rates EXC as a #2 Buy, making it a compelling option for income-focused investors seeking stable cash flow.

headlines.title: Are You Looking for a High-Growth Dividend Stock?
headlines.summary: Ameren, a St. Louis-based utility company, is presented as a strong dividend play with a current yield of 2.82% and an annualized dividend of $3.00, up 5.6% year-over-year. The company has consistently increased dividends over the past 5 years with an average annual increase of 7.11%. headlines.summary: Realty Income's 5.3% dividend yield offers only a modest 50 basis point premium over the 10-year Treasury yield, raising questions about its attractiveness. headlines.summary: Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRT) is experiencing elevated implied volatility in its November 2026 $80 call options, suggesting traders expect significant price movement. However, the company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with downward analyst revisions over the past 60 days, with consensus earnings estimates declining from $1.87 to $1.86 per share. headlines.title: PECO or REG: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
headlines.summary: Phillips Edison & Company (PECO) presents a better value opportunity than Regency Centers (REG) based on Zacks Rank and Style Scores analysis. PECO holds a #2 Buy rating with a Value grade of B, while REG has a #3 Hold rating with a Value grade of D. headlines.summary: Nucor stock declined 1.79% on September 8, 2026, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.58% loss and lagging the Basic Materials sector. headlines.title: Kinross Gold Stock Up 13% in a Month: What Should Investors Do Now?
headlines.summary: Kinross Gold (KGC) gained 12.7% in the past month driven by gold price recovery and solid earnings. While the company boasts a strong development pipeline expected to add 3 million ounces of production and maintains robust financial health with $4.4 billion in liquidity, it faces headwinds from elevated production costs and declining earnings estimates. The company maintains a Hold rating with limited near-term production growth expected through 2028.

headlines.title: Can NEM Maintain Earnings Momentum Amid Production Challenges?
headlines.summary: Newmont Corporation (NEM) reported a 13% year-over-year decline in Q2 gold production to 1.29 million ounces, with 2026 guidance showing further production decline to 5.26 million ounces. The company expects significantly higher all-in-sustaining costs of $1,680 per ounce in 2026 compared to $1,358 in 2025, driven by lower volumes, higher royalties, and deferred capital. headlines.summary: Mission Produce (AVO) expects record Peru avocado production of 120-130 million pounds in fiscal 2026, up 20% year-over-year, which should improve margins in the second half as supply shifts from Mexico toward Peru and California. The company forecasts second-half adjusted EBITDA of $84-$88 million, though third-quarter prices are expected to decline 15% year-over-year due to increased industry supply.

headlines.title: Can Southern Copper Sustain Its Strong Operating Cash Flow Growth?
headlines.summary: Southern Copper (SCCO) delivered a 116.9% year-over-year surge in operating cash flow to $3.68 billion in H1 2026, driven by higher sales and reduced operating costs. Despite a 3.8% decline in copper production, the company raised its 2026 production outlook to 917,000 tons and maintains a strong long-term outlook with production expected to reach 1.6 million tons by 2033-2034. Rising copper prices near $6.6 per pound and ongoing cost controls position the company for further gains.

headlines.title: Why Avery Dennison (AVY) is a Great Dividend Stock Right Now
headlines.summary: Avery Dennison (AVY) is highlighted as a compelling investment opportunity for income investors, offering a 2.28% dividend yield with consistent growth. The company has increased its dividend 5 times over the last 5 years with an average annual increase of 9.44%, and is expected to see earnings expansion with a 2026 consensus estimate of $10.16 per share, representing 6.61% year-over-year growth. On July 9, 2026, Rackspace cut full-year revenue guidance by $150 million, causing the stock to plunge 33.6%. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is September 28, 2026.

INTU.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Intuit Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

INTU.title: Deadline Alert: Intuit Inc. (INTU) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
INTU.summary: A class action securities fraud lawsuit has been filed against Intuit Inc. for allegedly making false statements about its business strength and competitive advantages. Investors who purchased Intuit securities between February 25, 2025 and June 1, 2026 have until September 8, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

AGX.title: Argan's Q2 Beat Shows Power Strength as Industrial Margins Stay Soft
AGX.summary: Argan, Inc. (AGX) reported strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with earnings up 50.4% and revenue up 61.5%, beating consensus estimates. Management expects Industrial margins to remain below historical norms for another 1-2 quarters.

AGX.title: AGX Falls 28.1% in a Month as Backlog and Margin Risks Come Into Focus
AGX.summary: Argan, Inc. (AGX) shares fell 28.1% over a month despite strong Q2 fiscal 2027 results with 61.5% revenue growth and 50.4% earnings increase. While the company maintains a debt-free balance sheet and strong growth metrics, elevated valuation at 33.1X trailing earnings and execution risks keep the investment case uncertain.

The region's momentum was broad-based across Japan, South Korea, and Greater China, with strong DTC performance and full-price discipline helping expand gross margins to 65.4%. However, the company carries a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating, and shares have declined 24.6% over three months.

CVE.title: Imperial Oil Stock Rises 49% YTD: Time to Hold or Lock in Profits?
CVE.summary: Imperial Oil (IMO) has gained 49% year-to-date but underperformed peers Suncor Energy and Cenovus Energy. While the company benefits from an integrated business model generating strong free cash flow (C$2.23B in Q2) and has growth potential through Kearl operations targeting 300,000 bpd at $18/barrel by 2027, it faces headwinds from commodity price exposure, uneven upstream volumes, and reduced 2026 refinery guidance due to operational disruptions. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

VSH.title: Vishay Intertechnology 45 mm Inductive Position Sensor Encoder Enables Reliable Operation Near Electric Motors
VSH.summary: Vishay Intertechnology introduced the MCB RAIK045I MP, a 45mm inductive position sensor encoder offering 16-bit resolution, ≥14-bit repeatability, and operation up to 10,000 rpm. The device is immune to external magnetic fields, making it suitable for use near electric motors in industrial applications including robotics, motor drives, conveyor systems, and agricultural equipment. Samples and production quantities are available with 16-week lead times.

NTNX.title: Nutanix Recognized in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Container Management for Second Consecutive Year
NTNX.summary: Nutanix has been recognized in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Container Management for the second consecutive year as a Challenger. The company's Kubernetes Platform (NKP) is designed to simplify Kubernetes operations across virtualized, bare-metal, public cloud, and edge environments. Nutanix also introduced NKP Metal to extend capabilities to bare-metal infrastructure deployments.

AXTA.title: Axalta Unveils Redefined as its 2027 Global Automotive Color of the Year
AXTA.summary: Axalta Coating Systems unveiled 'Redefined,' its 2027 Global Automotive Color of the Year, a deep ruby-red finish with a jewel-like appearance. The color represents an evolution of automotive red, combining heritage with modern sophistication and reflecting consumer demand for expressive yet refined vehicles. The announcement was made at Automechanika Frankfurt.

ALHC.title: Alignment Health Plan and Hoag Health System Increase Access to Award-Winning Care for Orange County Seniors
ALHC.summary: Alignment Health Plan announced an expanded partnership with Hoag Health System effective January 1, 2027, providing Medicare Advantage members in Orange County with in-network access to Hoag's physicians, hospitals, specialty programs, and urgent care facilities. The collaboration aims to improve healthcare access and affordability for seniors by combining Alignment's care model with Hoag's extensive local provider network.

RCI.title: Rogers et OEG Sports & Entertainment prolongent leur partenariat stratégique de 10 ans
RCI.summary: Rogers and OEG Sports & Entertainment announced a 10-year partnership extension through 2036, making Rogers Place the home of the Edmonton Oilers. As part of the celebration of Rogers Place's 10th anniversary, Rogers will distribute over 1,500 tickets to customers during the season, including 300 for the home opener on September 29 against Vancouver Canucks. The partnership includes media rights through Sportsnet and various fan engagement initiatives.

RCI.title: Rogers and OEG Sports & Entertainment Extend Strategic Partnership for 10 More Years
RCI.summary: Rogers and OEG Sports & Entertainment announced a 10-year extension of their strategic partnership, securing Rogers Place as the home of the Edmonton Oilers through 2036. To celebrate the arena's 10-year anniversary, Rogers is giving away over 1,500 tickets to customers throughout the season, including 300 for the Home Opener on September 29. The extension builds on an unprecedented sponsorship deal signed in 2013 and includes extensive brand placements and advertising across the arena.

BROS.title: Dutch Bros (BROS) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
BROS.summary: While Dutch Bros (BROS) has a strong average brokerage recommendation of 1.22 (Strong Buy), the article cautions that broker recommendations often have positive bias due to vested interests. BROS.title: Can MCD's Slower Expansion Pace Help Protect New-Restaurant Returns?
BROS.summary: McDonald's pushed back its goal of reaching 50,000 restaurants globally to 2028 from end of 2027, citing higher development costs and consumer headwinds. Despite the delay, the company plans approximately 2,600 gross openings in 2026, its fastest growth period ever, while maintaining focus on return quality over expansion pace. Competitors like Starbucks are taking selective approaches while Dutch Bros pursues faster expansion.

SBUX.summary: The global Quick Service Restaurants market is projected to grow from USD 1,064.44 billion in 2025 to USD 2,462.71 billion by 2035 at an 8.75% CAGR. Digital ordering and delivery services now account for 48% of QSR sales, with online orders exceeding 120 billion globally. North America leads with 34.65% market share, while Asia Pacific emerges as the fastest-growing region at 9.96% CAGR. Major players are investing in digital innovation, mobile apps, and contactless services to capture growing consumer demand for convenience.

ALL.summary: The U.S. personal auto insurance industry is transitioning from a rate-increase phase to competitive growth as loss ratios improve. ACIU.title: Verastem Stock Skyrockets 121% in 3 Months: Here Is Why
ACIU.summary: Verastem (VSTM) shares have surged 121% over three months, driven by accelerating sales of ovarian cancer drug Avmapki Fakzynja Co-Pack, which generated $25.1 million in Q2 2026 revenues (up 1,095% YoY), and growing optimism around VS-7375, a KRAS G12D inhibitor in phase II trials across pancreatic, lung, and colorectal cancers. The company expects VS-7375 data in October 2026 and plans FDA meetings before year-end to discuss phase III pivotal trial designs.

ACIU.title: CAPR Stock Skyrockets 144% in a Month: What Is Driving the Rally?
ACIU.summary: Capricor Therapeutics (CAPR) shares surged 144% over the past month following positive phase III HOPE-3 data showing a 54% reduction in upper-limb function decline for its deramiocel cell therapy in Duchenne muscular dystrophy. After an initial FDA rejection, the company refined its indication to focus on upper-limb function, and the FDA accepted the resubmission with a new PDUFA date of November 22, 2026. The stock rally reflects renewed investor optimism despite substantial regulatory risk.

AMWL.title: Amwell Receives Letter of Intent from Department of Veterans Affairs to Help Power its Digital Health Infrastructure
AMWL.summary: Amwell announced that the Department of Veterans Affairs has declared its intent to deploy Amwell's virtual health platform across the VA enterprise to modernize its digital health infrastructure and serve over nine million Veteran beneficiaries. The Letter of Intent follows a comprehensive VA evaluation that determined Amwell's platform aligns with the Department's strategic objectives, particularly in scalable video consultations, interoperability, cybersecurity compliance, and integrated care delivery. However, the Letter of Intent is non-binding and any formal agreement is contingent upon contract negotiation and federal procurement requirements.
